title: Alphabet, unlike Amazon, doesn’t get a pass on spending — does that make it a better investment?
text: Alphabet, unlike Amazon, doesn’t get a pass on spending — does that make it a better investment? More Alphabet reported excellent earnings, but the stock has been hit because the company projected higher expenses. There is quite a contrast between how investors treat Amazon (AMZN) and Alphabet (GOOG)(GOOGL) Investors love Amazon when it says it is going to spend more money, but they don’t feel the same way about Alphabet’s spending. Interestingly, Netflix (NFLX) gets a reaction somewhat similar to Amazon, but Facebook (FB) and Apple (AAPL) get a reaction somewhat similar to Alphabet.
